content.user_title: Draft VSME Reports and Customer ESG Responses
content.value_statement: Small businesses face sustainability questionnaires without a consistent reporting process. This guide helps organize company records into voluntary VSME report drafts and reusable customer responses.
actual_capabilities: Guide collection of VSME Basic module datapoints suitable for small businesses.
Organize energy consumption records from invoices and meter readings.
Structure Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions reporting using supplied official emission factors.
Organize workforce and governance information requested by banks and large customers.
Draft sustainability questionnaire responses from the company report.
Support a baseline report for comparison with future reporting periods.
limitations: This folder contains a public guide, not the original package scripts, extension source, or reporting templates.
Outputs are working drafts, not assured reports or substitutes for full CSRD or ESRS reporting.
Current official emission factors must be supplied or obtained separately and checked for regional relevance.
Comprehensive module coverage and legal claims about customer data requests are not substantiated by detailed procedures in this guide.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Voluntary Report
use_cases.description: Organize energy bills, meter readings, and workforce totals into a VSME Basic report draft with clear data gaps.

use_cases.title: Answer Customer ESG Questionnaires
use_cases.description: Map customer questions to available sustainability disclosures and draft consistent responses without inventing missing measurements.

use_cases.title: Establish an Annual Reporting Baseline
use_cases.description: Structure client energy, workforce, and governance records into a baseline that supports future reporting comparisons.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Data Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a VSME Basic data collection checklist for our [industry] business with [employee count] staff. Identify required records and missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: prepare company records before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a voluntary VSME Basic report from [company records] for [reporting period]. Separate supplied facts, missing data, and items requiring review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn available records into an internal draft.

prompt_templates.title: Map Customer Questions
prompt_templates.prompt: Map [customer ESG questionnaire] to our [VSME draft]. Draft answers supported by our records and list unsupported requests separately.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Emissions Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [energy records] and [official emission factors] for [period]. Structure Scope 1 and 2 disclosures, documenting sources, units, boundaries, and unresolved gaps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare traceable emissions disclosures for human review.

output_examples.input: We are a 40-person manufacturer preparing our first voluntary sustainability report. What records should we collect?
output: Energy: gather electricity invoices, fuel purchase records, and meter readings for the reporting period.
Emissions: identify current official factors relevant to each energy source and region.
Workforce: prepare aggregated headcount and applicable workforce records.
Governance: collect existing policies and identify missing disclosures before drafting.

output_examples.input: Our customer asks for annual electricity consumption and Scope 2 emissions. We have invoices but no verified emission factor.
output: Electricity consumption: total the invoice quantities for the reporting period and confirm the units.
Scope 2 emissions: pending selection of a current official emission factor appropriate to the reporting context.
Draft response: electricity consumption will be reported from invoices; the emissions figure remains pending factor verification.

output_examples.input: Can we send this voluntary report as an assured CSRD submission?
output_examples.output: No. This is a voluntary sustainability working draft, not an assured report or a full CSRD or ESRS submission.

best_practices: Retain source records, reporting periods, units, and emission factor references for every quantitative disclosure.
Use aggregated workforce data and share only company information authorized for the intended recipients.
Review drafts against the applicable VSME standard and verify legal statements before external use.
anti_patterns: Inventing missing company metrics or using emission factors without checking their source and applicability.
Presenting a draft as assured, fully CSRD compliant, or complete Comprehensive module coverage.
Rejecting customer data requests based on unverified claims about legal reporting limits.

faq.question: Who is this guide intended for?
faq.answer: It supports SMEs preparing voluntary sustainability information for banks, customers, and internal reporting.

faq.question: Does this replace CSRD or ESRS reporting?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on voluntary VSME reporting and does not provide full CSRD or ESRS compliance.

faq.question: Are scripts and reporting templates included?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed folder contains only the public guide; original scripts, extension source, and templates are absent.

faq.question: Where do emission factors come from?
faq.answer: Supply or obtain current official factors appropriate to the reporting period, region, and energy source.

faq.question: Can it help answer customer questionnaires?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides mapping customer questions to available disclosures and drafting answers supported by company records.

faq.question: Is the resulting report assured?
faq.answer: No. Outputs are working drafts that require human review and do not include independent assurance.
